name: Loopring
rootCause: Ethereum L2 protocol Loopring tweeted that it was hit by a large-scale DDoS attack. While the funds were not at risk, the service was down for 11 hours. Currently, domain access on the mobile app side has been reconfigured and the Loopring wallet service has been restored.
